entries.name: Create
entries.notes: Create selects declaration roles before family validation. Source actions and named Function invocations require complete verb families; lexical noun constructions require complete noun families. Ordinary values and non-callable applicational names remain labels. Dot-qualified authored references, declarations and import aliases reject with source attribution. Text, comments, numbers, paths, native/template contents and internal identities retain their separate meanings and bytes. The current CLI builds one standalone App with core Print and Text; this is compiler analysis, not runtime evidence.

entries.name: Define
entries.notes: Define distinguishes ordinary value bindings from lexical definitions. Framed native definitions select noun or verb roles from their declaration form and require complete families; Function data copies do not implicitly declare invocation verbs. Dot-qualified authored references, declarations and import aliases reject with source attribution. Text, comments, numbers, paths, native/template contents and internal identities retain their separate meanings and bytes. The current CLI builds one standalone App with core Print and Text; this is compiler analysis, not runtime evidence.

entries.name: Use

Renames and selected actor aliases declare complete families; alias chains cannot bypass validation. Ordinary value aliases remain data. Dot-qualified authored references, declarations and import aliases reject with source attribution. Text, comments, numbers, paths, native/template contents and internal identities retain their separate meanings and bytes.
